create_faiss_indexer: create an Indexer with a flat or PQ FAISS index for a given vector size
index_embeddings: index a set of document IDs and their embedding vectors into the FAISS index
search_knn_vectors: search the FAISS index with query vectors to retrieve top-k nearest neighbor document IDs and scores
serialize_faiss_index: serialize the FAISS index and its ID mapping metadata to disk files in a directory
deserialize_faiss_index: deserialize a FAISS index and its ID mapping metadata from disk files into an Indexer
